title: Big Muddy Adventures at the Boathouse
specs: Calm, current-free water conditions on Post Dispatch Lake
Weekly social paddle event for adults 60+
Guided 1-hour history kayak tours on Thursday evenings
$5 paddle board yoga classes offered in summer
Must be 16 or older to rent a boat without an adult present
16 and 17-year-olds must have a liability waiver signed by a parent or guardian
Children 12 or older may paddle with an adult supervising from another boat nearby
Weight limits: paddle boats 600 lbs, canoes and double kayaks 500 lbs, single kayaks and regular SUPs 250 lbs, XL SUPs 350 lbs
Groups of 10 or more boats require a reservation request form
includes: Life jackets included with all boat rentals
Paddles included with canoe, kayak, and SUP rentals
Bike lock and helmet included with bike rentals
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests rent paddle boats, canoes, kayaks, stand up paddle boards, or bikes to explore Post Dispatch Lake and Forest Park trails. Rentals include life jackets and paddles or helmets and locks for bikes. Special guided events include history kayak tours and social paddling for seniors.
extraNote: Boat rentals are first come, first serve; no reservations except for groups of 10 or more · Open 7 days a week, weather permitting, April 1 - October 31 · The Boathouse at 6101 Government Drive, St. Louis, MO 63110 · April 1 - October 31
